name: DeepSeek Harness
description: Runs coding agents on a plugin-composed harness where models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, and the UI are all swappable plugins.

skills.name: Plugin Composition
skills.description: Swaps models, tools, skills, sandboxes, and storage backends through one uniform plugin interface without forking the harness.

skills.name: Session Persistence
skills.description: Checkpoints agent session state so long-running tasks resume across restarts and survive switching the underlying model.

skills.name: Sandboxed Execution
skills.description: Executes agent-generated commands and code inside pluggable sandbox backends isolated from the host filesystem.
